records.name: Filtration Plant
records.reason: Retain six gold ports, actual lower slots, stepped shoulder and tall side channel. Focused highlighted phases and current native/import views do not establish another missing major assembly or a different collar/port arrangement.

records.name: Science Labs
records.reason: Retain the slender stepped spindle, silver open fork crown, real wells and flared bell foot. A gold crown copied from other facilities would contradict this source.

records.name: Construction Unit
records.reason: Retain paired open wells, pale uprights, lower rim slots and raised upper well. Current contacts and body divisions reproduce the visible construction; catalogue highlighting does not establish door motion.

records.name: Ground Deck
records.reason: Retain the bronze buttresses, surface panels, open shaft and two existing sliding covers. Composed source activity layers and actual closed/half/open GLB renders support this assembly. All 61 authored runtime poses were checked by the unchanged original validator.

records.name: Probe Launch
records.reason: Retain the open upper port, internal flat guides, flared collar and front fitting. The left dark sprite patch remains ambiguous shading; adding a second hole is unsupported.

records.name: Deep Space Probes
records.reason: Retain the stepped tip, red middle housing, exposed copper neck and slender coaxial pole/foot. The major visible colour and shape divisions are already present.

records.name: Gravitic Converter
records.reason: Retain the sphere, side braces, real front grille, side fittings and lower spindle/foot. Current renders preserve the visible gaps and main proportions without adding a speculative power mechanism.

records.name: Energy Globe
records.reason: Retain the segmented sphere, green service face, equatorial ring, neck and foot. The existing broad divisions and attached face already account for the source-visible equipment.

records.name: Shield Generator
records.reason: Retain three globes and feet, open mast supports and curved gold top. Actual gaps and the distinct upper spindle are present; extra antennas or another globe lack evidence.

records.name: Missile Launcher
records.reason: Retain the stepped green shell, segmented bronze foundation, front rungs, side rod and sideways opening dome halves. Original base/cover layers were composed at descriptor offsets; fresh native/import closed/half/open renders and aperture tests support retaining the previous launch animation.

records.name: Thermal Lance
records.reason: Retain the tapered pointed barrel, rounded short pivot housing, bronze side fittings and pedestal. All sixteen directional heads were composed over the base; they support the existing major forms. Directional yaw is not evidence for an autonomous firing or idle clip.

records.name: Storage racks
records.reason: Retain five bronze pods, pale rack, central join and green faces. Existing views reproduce the broad pod arrangement and material regions; hidden plumbing and precise pod curvature remain authored.

records.name: Ex-Fang
records.reason: Retain the thin concave dish, inclined support, central copper feed, four fittings and green pedestal. All sixteen complete directional sprites show the dish changing from a thin diagonal edge to a full circle. The steep oval in the current quarter render is camera/yaw presentation, not proof that physical dish inclination should change. No new idle sweep or pitch clip is established.

policy: Fresh source-specific runtime checks and focused visual review; unchanged models are not counted as new refinements
